## EMST role: Water and wastewater treatment operator (local variant, lead level; P2)

*Match:* `skos:closeMatch`, confidence 0.6, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-pa-phl:R25-water-wastewater-operator/local:7E49`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulated-party.

**Competency targets at this level (agent draft)**

- Operate drinking water treatment processes to meet water quality targets — lead L4 *(distinguishing)*
- Operate wastewater treatment and resource-recovery processes to permit limits — lead L4
- Practice within licensure scope and responsible charge — lead L4
- Supervise automated and AI-assisted process control in environmental operations — lead L4
- Protect operational technology at environmental utilities and facilities — lead L3
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — lead L3
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — lead L4
- Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites — lead L2
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — lead L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — lead L1
- Manage a municipal stormwater programme to meet permit conditions — lead L3

**Main tasks at this level (indicative % of time, agent draft)**

- Adjust coagulant dosing from jar test results when raw-water turbidity, temperature or organic content changes — 5.1% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Verify disinfection contact time against required inactivation values at each operating flow and correct shortfalls before water enters distribution — 4.7% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Adjust aeration and sludge wasting rates using solids inventory, settleability and dissolved-oxygen trends to hold effluent within permit limits — 4.7% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Diagnose a biological process upset from microscopic examination, foam, odor and settling behavior before laboratory results confirm it — 4.7% *(critical, needed at entry)*
- Determine whether an assigned task falls within the scope of one's licence or certification, referring out-of-scope work to a qualified professional — 4.7% *(critical)*
- Exercise responsible charge over subordinates' professional work, directing and reviewing it so that the sealing professional can attest to it — 4.7% *(critical)*
- Respond to a treatment upset by isolating the affected process unit, bringing backup treatment online and notifying the primacy agency — 3.7% *(needed at entry)*
- Supervise automated process-control loops, overriding setpoints when analyzer readings conflict with bench tests or visual plant checks — 3.7%
- Route peak wet-weather flows through the plant to protect biological treatment, recording any bypass or overflow for required reporting — 3.7% *(needed at entry)*
- Operate anaerobic digestion and solids handling to meet biosolids pathogen-reduction and stability requirements while recovering digester gas — 3.7% *(needed at entry)*
- Run a treatment process in safe manual operation when automation or communications fail, adapting the manual operating procedure to conditions — 3.7%
- Monitor automated control loops and alarms on a treatment process, checking automated responses against field observations of process condition — 3.7% *(needed at entry)*

*Credential gates (draft):* Drinking water treatment operator certification (Grades I-IV / Class A-D, state-specific) (required); Wastewater treatment operator certification (Grades I-IV) (required); Wastewater collection system operator certification (preferred); Water distribution system operator certification (preferred)
